description: Compare two lists of lines. text holds a line ---A---, then list A, then a line ---B---, then list B. The answer is a CSV of each distinct line, matched exactly as sent, marked only_a, only_b or both. It refuses empty text, more than 1,048,576 bytes or 50,000 lines, and a text without the two markers in that order. Free. The answer is the JSON envelope of https://foundry.dap.solutions/api/diff-two-line-lists, byte for byte, with the artifact hash that answered. Full rules: https://foundry.dap.solutions/hub.md

text.description: Two lists of lines: a line ---A---, then list A, then a line ---B---, then list B, one item per line. At most 1,048,576 bytes of UTF-8 and 50,000 lines; a line break at the very end is not a line.

name: diff-two-line-lists
title: Diff two line lists
